svg.title: ccinn.forward() — live inference
svg.desc: Animated ASCII dashboard: signals propagate through a 4-5-5-2 neural network from rust, go, c/c++ and php to build and ship; eight causal attention heads cycle over 'to know but not to do is not to know'; a sampler generates sentences token by token with top-3 probabilities.
svg.text: to kn bu no to do is no to kn

g.text: To know but not to do is not to know.
High QPS, fine-grained locks, zero panics.
Distributed systems are neural nets that page you at 3am.
